title: Material change invalidates affected verification evidence
invariant: Tests and reviews of a superseded state do not approve the current state.
given: A medium-risk change passed tests and independent review. Afterward, the Implementer modifies the same logic to address a newly found edge case. The relevant tests and Reviewer have not been rerun against the updated diff. The PM inspects the current state and recognizes that the prior evidence no longer establishes the changed logic.
when: The PM evaluates the current final state for integration.

must: treat the prior evidence as stale for the changed logic
rerun affected verification against the current state
obtain Reviewer coverage of the final relevant diff
must_not: reuse the earlier passing review as approval of the changed code
call the current state verified because the previous state passed

notes: Because the PM has evaluated the current state enough to identify stale evidence, G2 is INCONCLUSIVE rather than NOT_RUN. NOT_RUN is reserved for an expected verification check that was not executed at all.
